title: Atlas Crossing Partners | Wholesum Foods, Inc. | LBO Model — Overview
summary: Full LBO model for Wholesum Foods, Inc. (Fund III), covering the July 2018 entry through a projected Q3 2026 exit. Includes sources & uses at entry (Entry EV $214M, 11.6× EBITDA), a nine-year income statement with actuals through FY2024A and projections through FY2026E, a detailed debt schedule (Senior TL at 5.5× + Mezz PIK at 2.0×), and a returns summary. Base case projects Exit EV of $212.8M at 9.5× FY2026E EBITDA of $22.4M; includes a $49.8M partial recap in October 2024. Base case gross MOIC of 2.8× and gross IRR of ~19.2% on an 8-year hold; net MOIC ~2.3× and net IRR ~15.4%. EBITDA margin has compressed from 22.5% at entry to ~16% by exit. Returns sensitivity tables across 5 exit multiples and 5 EBITDA scenarios are provided.

growth_drivers: Partial recapitalization in October 2024 generating $49.8M proceeds
Debt paydown on senior term loan via mandatory amortization and cash flow sweep
risks: PIK mezz debt accreting significantly — ending balance grows from $37M to $98.6M by exit
EBITDA margin compression from 22.5% at entry to ~16% by FY2026E
High total leverage (7.5× Debt/EBITDA through mid-hold period)
Modest revenue growth (2–5% YoY in later years)
Net debt at exit ($98.0M) constrains equity value
